defensives.name: Unending Resolve
defensives.usage_rule: Press before a large incoming magic or physical hit for a 40% damage reduction and interrupt immunity; your strongest planned defensive for scripted burst.

defensives.name: Dark Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Sacrifice current health into a large absorb shield ahead of predictable damage; talent-gated so its absence is expected on builds that skip it.

defensives.name: Mortal Coil
defensives.usage_rule: Use to instantly heal a chunk of your health while horrifying the target when you need a quick personal recovery; talent-gated.
